items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: He knew how he was, even with the tenor player... Paul Gonsalves... I went to his dressing room... I said, 'Hi Duke' and he raised his arm... shook hands with him

ctx.x: Oh, he never said nothing to me. He'd say, 'What's the matter?' and I'd say, 'You know what it is. How can you stand all that stuff like that?' But he knew how he was, even with the tenor player -- what was his name?

Yeah, Paul. He's sleeping out there in front of the public, sleeping and so forth like that -- Oh, he take a lot of things. (Unintelligible) how can you take all that? I don't know. I guess he figured he couldn't get anybody like him.
